name: rates-bonds/muni-reinvestment-flow
title: Muni reinvestment flow — long munis vs β-hedged Treasuries, first 5 sessions of each month
description: Muni coupons and redemptions pay on the 1st of the month and funds reinvest that cash in the first days, so munis beat duration-hedged Treasuries early in the month. Long MUB/TFI/ITM/SHM at 0.25 each, short 252-day-beta × IEF (vs MUB/TFI/ITM) and × SHY (vs SHM), from the last NYSE close of the month through the close of session 5; flat otherwise.

backtest.cost_type: all-in (spread + fee), charged per unit of turnover on every leg
backtest.sharpe_oos_note: 2008-16 ETF prices (not the discovery window); 2017-26 discovery window 0.88

live_notes: SIM book: filled at the yfinance daily close with no order book, rejection, partial fill or borrow cost. Weaker evidence than a venue fill; do not read this Sharpe as exchange-cleared.

Borderline by the report's own verdict: 0.18 in the 2008-16 ETF sample, 0.88 in 2017-26 which is the DISCOVERY window, deflated-Sharpe probability 0.44 over 45 trials. The out-of-sample support is the mechanism on muni fund NAVs (t 2.5 in 2000-07 and 2008-16), not the ETF book. Intended as a small diversifier to treasury-flow-calendar (corr ≈ 0), not a standalone book. Expect Sharpe 0.5-0.9; 2024-25 were flat.

Cost: broker set to 1 bp slippage + 1 bp fee = the research's 2 bp/side all-in on every leg. Cost ladder full-sample: 1 bp 0.76, 2 bp 0.52, 3 bp 0.29, 5 bp -0.17. Do not rebuild with the 10 bp default.
Scale 1 (the validated book): gross 1.37 avg / 1.74 max on held days; max_gross 1.8 is a backstop. The report's blend with TFC used 2.9× — not deployed here.

Calendar: strategy.py extends the index with its own NYSE holiday rules (New Year handled correctly, unlike treasury-flow-calendar). One-off closures are not in the rules; an unexpected closure shifts the window a day.

Runs at 00:00 UTC (after the NYSE close) and trades only when the bar all six legs agree on changes; refuses a still-forming bar and any leg missing the latest bar. Round trips ≈ 12/yr (one per month, all six legs).
